## SelectorReference interface

One object denoted by a selection rule, bound to the client that decoded it.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface SelectorReference<T, R extends string = string> extends SelectorReferenceData<R>, ObjectReference<T, R>
```

**Extends:** [SelectorReferenceData](./contracts.selectorreferencedata.md)<!-- -->&lt;R&gt;, [ObjectReference](./contracts.objectreference.md)<!-- -->&lt;T, R&gt;
